        --expected-session "$operator" --confirm-side-effects --args "$args" \
        "plugins/incus/operations/$method/call" > "$work/$method-$device.receipt.json" \
        2> "$work/$method-$device.diagnostic"; then
        cat "$work/$method-$device.diagnostic" >&2
        fail "incus/$method failed or outcome is unknown; retain intent/evidence, do not retry or bypass admission"
    fi
    jq -e --arg method "$method" --arg name "$name" --arg device "$device" '
        .plugin_id=="incus" and .method==$method and
        .result.success==true and .result.plugin_id=="incus" and .result.method==$method and
        .result.result.instance_name==$name and .result.result.device_name==$device
    ' "$work/$method-$device.receipt.json" >/dev/null || fail 'device receipt target differs'
    verify_control_mount
    read_instance
    printf '%s\n' "$instance" > "$work/$method-$device.instance.json"
}
jq '.phase="root-bind-intent"' "$receipt" > "$receipt.new"
sync -f "$receipt.new"
mv -T "$receipt.new" "$receipt"
for device in 3tchedfs system-bus; do
    if jq -e --arg device "$device" '.devices|has($device)' <<<"$instance" >/dev/null; then
        args=$(jq -cn --arg name "$name" --arg device "$device" '{instance_name:$name,device_name:$device}')
        mutate_device remove_device "$device" "$args"
    fi
    jq -e --arg device "$device" 'all(.devices,.expanded_devices; has($device)|not)' <<<"$instance" >/dev/null || fail "host device still present: $device"
done
if jq -e '.devices|has("fuse")' <<<"$instance" >/dev/null; then
    jq -e '.devices.fuse=={type:"unix-char",source:"/dev/fuse",path:"/dev/fuse"}' <<<"$instance" >/dev/null || fail 'different fuse device'
else
    args=$(jq -cn --arg name "$name" '{instance_name:$name,device_name:"fuse",device:{type:"unix-char",source:"/dev/fuse",path:"/dev/fuse"}}')
    mutate_device add_device fuse "$args"
fi
jq -e 'all(.devices,.expanded_devices; .fuse=={type:"unix-char",source:"/dev/fuse",path:"/dev/fuse"})' <<<"$instance" >/dev/null || fail 'guest fuse device readback differs'
fstab_tmp=$(mktemp "$root/@/etc/.fstab.XXXXXX")
guest_fstab filter "$pool/.provisioning/$name.fstab.before" > "$fstab_tmp"
chmod --reference="$root/@/etc/fstab" "$fstab_tmp"
chown --reference="$root/@/etc/fstab" "$fstab_tmp"
sync -f "$fstab_tmp"
mv -T "$fstab_tmp" "$root/@/etc/fstab"
printf '%s\n' "$sid" > "$root/@/etc/hostname"

# mutation. This remains explicit host maintenance, never a denial fallback.
timeout --kill-after=5s 30s incus --force-local --project default config set "$name" "volatile.last_state.idmap=$idmap" || fail 'host idmap maintenance failed; reconcile before retry'
sync -f "$root"
mkdir -p "$view" "$seed_layer" "$upgrade_layer"
mount --bind -o ro,X-mount.idmap=b:0:1000000:1000000000 "$root/@" "$seed_layer"
mount --bind -o ro,X-mount.idmap=b:0:1000000:1000000000 "$replica/@" "$upgrade_layer"

guest_fstab verify "$view/etc/fstab"
mount --bind "$view" "$container_root"
for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
    mount --bind -o X-mount.idmap=b:0:1000000:1000000000 "$root/@agent_$member" "$container_root/agent/$member"
    case "$member" in shared|soul) mount -o remount,bind,ro "$container_root/agent/$member" ;; esac
done
mount --bind -o X-mount.idmap=b:0:1000000:1000000000 "$root/@agent_user/persist" "$container_root/opt/run-mounts/persist"
read_instance
[[ $(select_idmap) == "$idmap" ]] || fail 'container idmap changed during binding'
jq -e --arg idmap "$idmap" '.config["volatile.last_state.idmap"]==$idmap and
    all(.devices,.expanded_devices; .fuse=={type:"unix-char",source:"/dev/fuse",path:"/dev/fuse"} and
        (has("3tchedfs")|not) and (has("system-bus")|not))' <<<"$instance" >/dev/null || fail 'final guest device/idmap readback differs'
[[ $(findmnt -rn -M "$container_root" -o FSTYPE) == overlay ]] || fail 'effective guest root is not the prepared overlay'
guest_fstab verify "$container_root/etc/fstab"
jq --arg root "$container_root" --arg view "$view" --argjson instance "$instance" \
   '.phase="root-bound"|.root_bound=true|.threetched_root=$root|.instance=$instance|
    .root_view=$view|.root_view_readonly=true|.upgrade_paired=true|
    .guest_fuse_configured=true|.guest_fuse_mounted=false|.host_fuse_mirrored=false' "$receipt" > "$receipt.new"
sync -f "$receipt.new"
mv -T "$receipt.new" "$receipt"
sync -f "$pool/.provisioning"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Pin the manually prepared GPT/overlay instance for identity-owner adoption.
# No format, member changes, start, credentials, grants or identity-store writes.
set -euo pipefail

secure_path() (
    path=$1
    [[ $(realpath -e -- "$path") == "$path" ]] || fail "noncanonical path: $path"
    while :; do
        [[ ! -L $path && $(stat -c %u -- "$path") == 0 ]] &&
            (( (8#$(stat -c %a -- "$path") & 022) == 0 )) || fail "unsafe owner/mode: $path"
        [[ $path != / ]] || break
        path=$(dirname -- "$path")
    done
)
[[ $# == 1 && $1 =~ ^(3tchedCtlChatbot|3tchedChatbot|ID-[1-9][0-9]*)$ && ${#1} -le 63 && $(id -u) == 0 ]] || fail 'usage (host root): prepare-chatbot-adoption NAME (existing configured chatbot)'
umask 077
name=$1

sid=b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28
key=[REDACTED:opaque-base64]
operator=${OP_3TCHEDFS_EXPECTED_SESSION-414fbc56-03fb-20ab-758a-bcc7a7cbdc0e}
client=${THREETCHED_FS:-/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin/3tched-fs}
control_mount=${OP_3TCHEDFS_MOUNT:-/run/mounts/3tchedFS}
# --expected-session checks the existing mounted caller; it does not inject an
# identity or use a different principal when admission fails.
[[ -x $client && $operator =~ ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$ ]] || fail 'mounted client or canonical expected caller session absent'
command -v timeout >/dev/null || fail 'timeout is required for bounded preflight'
pool=/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/3tched-pool
secure_path "$pool"
[[ $(stat -c %u:%g "$pool") == 0:0 &&
   $(findmnt -rn -M "$pool" -o FSTYPE) == btrfs &&
   $(findmnt -rn -M "$pool" -o FSROOT) == / &&
   $(findmnt -rn -M "$pool" -o UUID) == a1ab7b42-12a8-437c-8f65-d0469892c8dd &&
   $(findmnt -rn -M / -o UUID) != a1ab7b42-12a8-437c-8f65-d0469892c8dd ]] ||
    fail 'canonical loop pool is not mounted on its pinned filesystem'
secure_path "$pool/.provisioning"
[[ -d $pool/.provisioning && $(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$pool/.provisioning") == 0:0:700 ]] ||
    fail 'preparation receipt directory must be private'
disk=$pool/.provisioning/$name.json
container=$pool/.provisioning/$name.incus.json
plans=/var/lib/op-dbus/identity-provision-plans
[[ -f $disk && ! -L $disk && -f $container && ! -L $container ]] || fail 'operator preparation receipts absent'
for file in "$disk" "$container"; do
    secure_path "$file"
    [[ $(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$file") == 0:0:600 ]] || fail "unsafe preparation receipt: $file"
done

jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg image "$pool/$name.img" '
    .name==$name and .image==$image and .filesystem_prepared==true and
    .phase=="filesystems-prepared" and .layout=="raw-gpt-root-upgrade-v1"
' "$disk" >/dev/null || fail 'disk preparation incomplete'

    --arg root "/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/identity-roots/containers/$name/rootfs" \
    --arg view "$pool/.mounts/$name/root-view" '
    .version==1 and .name==$name and .session_id==$sid and .phase=="root-bound" and
    .root_bound==true and .upgrade_paired==true and .root_view_readonly==true and .identity_registered==false and
    .threetched_root==$root and .root_view==$view and .instance.name==$name and .instance.type=="container" and
    .instance.config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid and .instance.config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key and
    (.instance.config["volatile.uuid"]|type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"))
' "$container" >/dev/null || fail 'configured chatbot root binding differs or is already adopted'
native_uuid=$(jq -er '.instance.config["volatile.uuid"]' "$container")

[[ $(realpath -e "$plans") == "$plans" && $(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$plans") == 0:0:700 ]] || fail 'unsafe private plan directory'
[[ ! -e $plans/$sid.json && ! -L $plans/$sid.json ]] || fail 'existing plan must be reconciled; never overwrite it'

    2> "$work/preflight-diagnostic"; then

jq -ce --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" '
    select(.plugin_id=="identity_sled" and .method=="inspect_provision_preflight") |
    .result | select(.success==true and .plugin_id=="identity_sled" and .method=="inspect_provision_preflight") |
    .result | select(.session_id==$sid and .wireguard_pubkey==$key) |
    select(.previous_instance==null and .previous_native_instance==null and .previous_instance_etag=="") |

curl --silent --show-error --fail --noproxy '*' --max-time 30 --unix-socket "$socket" \
    --dump-header "$work/instance.headers" --output "$work/instance-response.json" \
    "http://unix.socket/1.0/instances/$name"

    select(.type=="sync" and .status_code==200)|.metadata|
    select(.name==$name and .type=="container" and .status=="Stopped" and .status_code==102 and

        .config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key)' \
    "$work/instance-response.json" > "$work/instance.json" || fail 'stopped Incus definition absent'
etag=$(awk 'tolower($1)=="etag:" {sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, ""); sub(/\r$/, ""); print}' "$work/instance.headers")
[[ -n $etag && $etag != *$'\n'* ]] || fail 'ambiguous Incus ETag'
timeout --kill-after=5s 30s incus --force-local query "/1.0/storage-pools/identity-roots?project=default" > "$work/pool.json"
root=$(jq -er .root_mount "$disk")
[[ $root == "$pool/.mounts/$name/root" && $(findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o FSTYPE) == btrfs ]] || fail 'prepared root mount absent'
members='{}'
for member in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
    show=$(btrfs subvolume show "$root/$member")
    id=$(awk '$1=="Subvolume" && $2=="ID:" {print $3}' <<<"$show")
    uuid=$(awk '$1=="UUID:" {print $2}' <<<"$show")
    members=$(jq -cn --argjson members "$members" --arg name "$member" --argjson id "$id" --arg uuid "$uuid" '$members+{($name):{id:$id,uuid:$uuid}}')

    unique | select(length==1) | .[0]') || fail 'unique physical seed source absent'
seed=$(realpath -e -- "$seed")
[[ -b $seed && $(blkid -p -s UUID -o value "$seed") == "$seed_fsid" &&
   $(blockdev --getro "$seed") == 1 ]] || fail 'physical seed identity or read-only protection differs'
seed_loop=$(jq -er .seed_loop "$disk")
[[ $seed_loop =~ ^/dev/loop[0-9]+$ && -b $seed_loop &&
   $(blockdev --getro "$seed_loop") == 1 && $(losetup -n -O RO "$seed_loop") == 1 &&
   $(realpath -e -- "$(losetup -n -O BACK-FILE "$seed_loop")") == "$seed" &&

   $(losetup -n -O SIZELIMIT "$seed_loop") == 0 &&
   $(blkid -p -s UUID -o value "$seed_loop") == "$seed_fsid" ]] ||
    fail 'read-only seed loop backing differs'

   $(stat -c %i "$image") == "$(jq -r .image_inode "$disk")" &&
   $(stat -c %s "$image") == "$(jq -r .image_bytes "$disk")" ]] || fail 'prepared image pins differ'

    --argjson inode "$(stat -c %i "$image")" --argjson size "$(stat -c %s "$image")" \
    --argjson persist "$(stat -c %i "$root/@agent_user/persist")" \

    --slurpfile instance "$work/instance.json" --slurpfile old "$work/preflight.json" '
    $disk[0] as $d | $d.partition_table.partitions as $p |
    {version:4,session_id:$sid,wireguard_pubkey:$key,
     expected_revision:$old[0].expected_revision,expected_revision_operation_id:$old[0].expected_revision_operation_id,
     binding:{device_path:$d.image,mount_point:$d.root_mount,btrfs_uuid:$d.root_fsid,cozo_id:$sid,attached:true},
     seed_device:$seed,seed_fsid:$d.seed_fsid,seed_generation:$generation,leaf_inode:$inode,leaf_size:$size,
     members:$members,persist_inode:$persist,native_root:$container[0].threetched_root,
     pool_name:$pool[0].name,pool_source:$pool[0].config.source,instance_etag:$etag,instance:$instance[0],
     previous_instance_etag:"",previous_instance:null,
     partitioned_overlay:{disk_guid:($d.partition_table.id|ascii_downcase),
      root_partition:{partuuid:($p[0].uuid|ascii_downcase),start_sector:$p[0].start,sectors:$p[0].size},

plan_tmp=$(mktemp "$plans/.$sid.XXXXXX")
cat "$work/plan.json" > "$plan_tmp"
sync -f "$plan_tmp"
ln "$plan_tmp" "$plans/$sid.json"
rm -- "$plan_tmp"
sync -f "$plans/$sid.json"
sync -f "$plans"
digest=$(sha256sum "$plans/$sid.json"); digest=${digest%% *}

[ -d "$pool/.provisioning" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$pool/.provisioning")" = 0:0:700 ] ||
    fail 'preparation receipt directory must be private'
for file in "$receipt" "$binding" "$disk"; do
    secure_path "$file"
    [ -f "$file" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$file")" = 0:0:600 ] || fail "unsafe preparation receipt: $file"
done
jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" '
    .version==1 and .name==$name and .session_id==$sid and
    .identity_registered==true and .restore_existing_pair==true
' "$receipt" >/dev/null || fail 'chatbot boot attestation differs'
# The boot opt-in is not identity authority. Match the host preparation's
# existing native UUID/session/key and storage paths before any mount action.
jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" --arg root "$root" --arg view "$view" '
    .version==1 and .name==$name and .session_id==$sid and .phase=="root-bound" and
    .root_bound==true and .root_view_readonly==true and .upgrade_paired==true and
    .threetched_root==$root and .root_view==$view and .instance.name==$name and .instance.type=="container" and
    .instance.config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid and .instance.config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key and
    (.instance.config["volatile.uuid"]|type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"))
' "$binding" >/dev/null || fail 'chatbot preparation pins differ'
uuid=$(jq -er '.instance.config["volatile.uuid"]' "$binding")
jq -e --arg uuid "$uuid" '
    (has("instance_uuid")|not) or .instance_uuid==$uuid
' "$receipt" >/dev/null || fail 'boot native UUID differs'
jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg image "$pool/$name.img" --arg root "$pool/.mounts/$name/root" \
    --arg upgrade "$pool/.mounts/$name/upgrade" '
    .name==$name and .layout=="raw-gpt-root-upgrade-v1" and .phase=="filesystems-prepared" and
    .filesystem_prepared==true and .image==$image and .root_mount==$root and .upgrade_mount==$upgrade
' "$disk" >/dev/null || fail 'disk preparation pins differ'
image=$pool/$name.img
secure_path "$image"
[ -f "$image" ] && [ "$(stat -c %i "$image")" = "$(jq -r .image_inode "$disk")" ] &&
    [ "$(stat -c %s "$image")" = "$(jq -r .image_bytes "$disk")" ] || fail 'image pins differ'
instance=$(readback incus --force-local query "/1.0/instances/$name?project=default") || fail 'native instance readback failed'
printf '%s\n' "$instance" | jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" --arg uuid "$uuid" '
    .name==$name and .type=="container" and .config["volatile.uuid"]==$uuid and
    .config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid and .config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key and
    .config["security.privileged"]=="false" and .config["security.protection.shift"]=="true" and
    .config["boot.autostart"]=="false" and .profiles==["3tched-lungs"] and
    .devices.root.type=="disk" and .devices.root.path=="/" and .devices.root.pool=="identity-roots" and
    ((.status=="Stopped" and .status_code==102) or (.status=="Running" and .status_code==103))
' >/dev/null || fail 'native chatbot UUID/session/key/policy differs'
state=$(printf '%s\n' "$instance" | jq -er .status)
# Select the activated closure deliberately. When invoked from a source or
# received release, use that helper's sibling; never fall through to base copies.
self=$(realpath -e -- "$0") || fail 'cannot resolve restore helper'
helper_dir=$(dirname -- "$self")
case "$helper_dir" in
    /usr/local/libexec/3tched)
        helper_dir=/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/helpers ;;
esac
sync_helper=$helper_dir/sync-instance-upgrade
case "$self" in
    */deploy/runit/libexec-3tched/restore-chatbot-root)
        sync_helper=$helper_dir/../../scripts/sync-instance-upgrade.sh ;;
esac
sync_helper=$(realpath -e -- "${OP_SYNC_INSTANCE_UPGRADE_HELPER:-$sync_helper}") || fail 'selected sync helper absent'
secure_path "$sync_helper"
[ -f "$sync_helper" ] && [ -x "$sync_helper" ] || fail 'selected sync helper not executable'
if [ "$state" = Running ]; then
    # A service restart observes only; it must not replace a running guest's lowers.
    [ "$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o FSTYPE)" = overlay ] || fail 'running root is not overlay'
    options=$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o FS-OPTIONS) || fail 'cannot inspect running root'
    case ",$options," in *,"lowerdir=$upgrade_layer:$seed_layer",*) ;; *) fail 'running root lower pins differ' ;; esac
    case ",$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o VFS-OPTIONS)," in *,ro,*) ;; *) fail 'running root is not read-only' ;; esac
    exit 0
fi
[ "$check_only" != true ] || exit 0
exec "$sync_helper" boot "$name"

#!/bin/sh
# Restore only receipt-selected existing roots after Incus readiness. Numbered
# names are selectors, never identity authority. Preflight all boot selections
# before restoring anything; conflicting logical identities fail closed.
# This base-owned service is not installed/enabled by application activation.
exec 2>&1
rm -f /run/opdbus/runit-ready/identity-roots
fail() { printf 'identity-roots: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
secure_path() (
    path=$1
    [ "$(realpath -e -- "$path")" = "$path" ] || fail "noncanonical path: $path"
    while :; do
        [ ! -L "$path" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u -- "$path")" = 0 ] &&
            [ $((0$(stat -c %a -- "$path") & 022)) -eq 0 ] || fail "unsafe owner/mode: $path"
        [ "$path" != / ] || break
        path=$(dirname -- "$path")
    done
)
private_receipt() {
    secure_path "$1" || return 1
    [ -f "$1" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$1")" = 0:0:600 ]
}
wait_dep() {
    sv start "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    i=0
    until sv check "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
        i=$((i + 1))
        [ "$i" -ge 90 ] && fail "dependency $1 not ready after 90s"
        sleep 1
    done
}
wait_dep incus
i=0
until incus info >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    [ "$i" -lt 60 ] || fail 'incusd API not ready'
    sleep 1
done
# Deliberate release-owned dependency selection; a partial/broken activated
# closure is an error, not permission to execute an older base helper.
if [ "${OP_IDENTITY_HELPER_DIR+x}" = x ]; then
    helper_dir=$OP_IDENTITY_HELPER_DIR
else
    helper_dir=/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/helpers
fi
helper_dir=$(realpath -e -- "$helper_dir") || fail 'selected helper directory absent'
secure_path "$helper_dir" || exit 1
for dependency in op-identity-root op-identity-image restore-chatbot-root sync-instance-upgrade runit-ready-signal; do
    secure_path "$helper_dir/$dependency" || exit 1
    [ -f "$helper_dir/$dependency" ] && [ -x "$helper_dir/$dependency" ] || fail "selected helper unavailable: $dependency"
done
helper=$helper_dir/op-identity-root
restore_helper=$helper_dir/restore-chatbot-root
# Keep the entire root-helper chain in the selected closure.
OP_IDENTITY_IMAGE_HELPER=$helper_dir/op-identity-image
OP_SYNC_INSTANCE_UPGRADE_HELPER=$helper_dir/sync-instance-upgrade
export OP_IDENTITY_IMAGE_HELPER OP_SYNC_INSTANCE_UPGRADE_HELPER
chatbot_session=b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28
pool=/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/3tched-pool
# An absent pool must not hide GPT receipts and select the legacy root path.
secure_path "$pool" || exit 1
[ "$(stat -c %u:%g "$pool")" = 0:0 ] &&
    [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$pool" -o FSTYPE)" = btrfs ] &&
    [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$pool" -o FSROOT)" = / ] &&
    [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$pool" -o UUID)" = a1ab7b42-12a8-437c-8f65-d0469892c8dd ] &&
    [ "$(findmnt -rn -M / -o UUID)" != a1ab7b42-12a8-437c-8f65-d0469892c8dd ] ||
    fail 'canonical loop pool is not mounted on its pinned filesystem'
if [ -e "$pool/.provisioning" ] || [ -L "$pool/.provisioning" ]; then
    secure_path "$pool/.provisioning" || exit 1
    [ -d "$pool/.provisioning" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$pool/.provisioning")" = 0:0:700 ] ||
        fail 'preparation receipt directory must be private'
fi
physical=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
legacy=${IDENTITIES:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities}
gpt_present=0
gpt_name=
physical_present=0
physical_names=
selected_sessions='|'
# GPT boot receipts attest completed adoption; restore --check verifies exact
# native UUID/session/key plus the corresponding private disk/root receipts.
# Restoration needs no online preparation replay, regardless of native name.
# Never execute restoration while another receipt could name the same chatbot.
for receipt in "$pool"/.provisioning/*.boot.json; do
    [ -e "$receipt" ] || [ -L "$receipt" ] || continue
    gpt_present=1
    private_receipt "$receipt" || fail "unsafe GPT boot receipt: $receipt"
    name=$(basename "$receipt" .boot.json)
    [ -z "$gpt_name" ] || fail 'multiple GPT chatbot boot receipts; reconcile before restoration'
    "$restore_helper" --check "$name" || fail "invalid GPT chatbot boot receipt: $name"
    gpt_name=$name
    selected_sessions="$selected_sessions$chatbot_session|"
done
for receipt in "$physical"/*/state.json; do
    [ -e "$receipt" ] || [ -L "$receipt" ] || continue
    physical_present=1
    name=$(basename "$(dirname "$receipt")")
    marker=$physical/$name/boot-ready.json
    if [ ! -e "$marker" ] && [ ! -L "$marker" ]; then
        echo "physical seed $name: no authoritative-completion boot opt-in; skipped"
        continue
    fi
    private_receipt "$receipt" && private_receipt "$marker" || fail "unsafe physical boot receipts: $name"
    # Keep existing canonical UUID roots. Both chatbot name forms require the
    # same pinned session and complete boot/storage receipt; neither grants identity.
    jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$chatbot_session" '
        .version==1 and .layout=="shared-partition-siblings-v2" and .name==$name and .phase=="ready" and
        (.session|type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$")) and
        (.instance_uuid|type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$")) and
        (.session==$name or (.session==$sid and
            ($name|test("^(3tchedCtlChatbot|3tchedChatbot|ID-[1-9][0-9]*)$") and length<=63)))
    ' "$receipt" >/dev/null || fail "invalid/incomplete physical boot receipt: $name"
    policy=$(jq -er '.start_on_boot|select(type=="boolean")|tostring' "$marker") || fail "invalid physical boot policy: $name"
    expected=$(jq -cS --argjson start "$policy" '{version,layout,image,members,persist,name,session,instance_uuid,root,seed_fsid,seed_generation,sprout_fsid,leaf,leaf_inode,leaf_size,start_on_boot:$start}' "$receipt") || fail "invalid storage pins: $name"
    actual=$(jq -cS . "$marker") || fail "invalid boot marker: $name"
    [ "$expected" = "$actual" ] || fail "physical boot/storage pins differ: $name"
    session=$(jq -er .session "$receipt") || fail "missing physical session: $name"
    case "$selected_sessions" in
        *"|$session|"*) fail "conflicting boot receipts for logical identity $session; no roots restored" ;;
    esac
    selected_sessions="$selected_sessions$session|"
    physical_names="$physical_names $name"
done
failed=0
if [ -n "$gpt_name" ]; then
    "$restore_helper" "$gpt_name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
fi
seed_readonly_ready=0
for name in $physical_names; do
    receipt=$physical/$name/state.json
    marker=$physical/$name/boot-ready.json
    start_on_boot=$(jq -er '.start_on_boot|select(type=="boolean")|tostring' "$marker") || fail "invalid boot policy: $name"
    # The helper checks the complete boot/storage marker, native UUID and
    # session/key binding again under its lifecycle lock before touching roots.
    if [ "$seed_readonly_ready" -eq 0 ]; then
        "$helper" seed-readonly || fail 'physical seed read-only enforcement failed'
        seed_readonly_ready=1
    fi
    state=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$name/state" | jq -er '.status') || state=unknown
    case "$state" in
        Running)
            if "$helper" seed-check "$name"; then
                "$helper" seed-lungs "$name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
            else failed=$((failed + 1)); fi
            ;;
        Stopped)
            if "$helper" seed-up "$name" && "$helper" seed-lungs "$name"; then
                if [ "$start_on_boot" = true ]; then incus start "$name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
                else echo "physical seed $name: storage restored; boot start disabled"; fi
            else failed=$((failed + 1)); fi
            ;;
        *) echo "physical seed $name: unsupported native status $state" >&2
            failed=$((failed + 1)) ;;
    esac
done
if [ "$physical_present" -eq 1 ] || [ "$gpt_present" -eq 1 ]; then
    # Never select legacy `up`: directly mounting the same seed conflicts with
    # retained sprouts even when another identity's root failed restoration.
    for image in "$legacy"/*/identity.img; do
        [ -f "$image" ] || continue
        name=$(basename "$(dirname "$image")")
        case "$selected_sessions" in
            *"|$name|"*) echo "legacy identity $name: suppressed by selected boot receipt"; continue ;;
        esac
        if { [ "$name" = 3tchedChatbot ] || [ "$name" = 3tchedCtlChatbot ]; } && [ "$gpt_present" -eq 1 ]; then
            echo "legacy identity $name: suppressed by GPT boot receipt"
        elif [ -e "$physical/$name/state.json" ] || [ -L "$physical/$name/state.json" ]; then
            echo "legacy identity $name: suppressed by physical seed receipt"
        else
            echo "legacy identity $name: migration or independent lower required; shared seed direct mount suppressed" >&2
            failed=$((failed + 1))
        fi
    done
else
    "$helper" up || failed=$((failed + 1))
    "$helper" status || failed=$((failed + 1))
fi
[ "$failed" -eq 0 ] || fail "$failed identity root startup check(s) failed"
"$helper_dir/runit-ready-signal" identity-roots || exit 1
exec sleep infinity

</content>
</file>

//! Fresh same-key adoption of an externally prepared shared-seed container.
//! The owner verifies native/storage state and performs only an atomic identity commit.
use super::*;
use anyhow::{Result, ensure};
use op_cozo_store::{CleanProvisionReceipt, IdentityCleanProvision};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{identity_sled::SledBtrfsDevice, incus::IncusRootRepairBackend};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::{
    collections::BTreeMap,
    path::{Component, Path},
};

#[path = "identity_clean_provision/storage.rs"]
mod storage;

const PLAN_DIR: &str = "/var/lib/op-dbus/identity-provision-plans";
const PARTITIONED_POOL: &str = "/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/3tched-pool";
const PARTITIONED_POOL_FSID: &str = "a1ab7b42-12a8-437c-8f65-d0469892c8dd";
const MEMBERS: [&str; 7] = [
    "@",
    "@agent_memory",
    "@agent_rules",
    "@agent_shared",
    "@agent_skills",
    "@agent_soul",
    "@agent_user",
];

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct MemberPin {
    id: u64,
    uuid: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct PartitionPin {
    partuuid: String,
    start_sector: u64,
    sectors: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct PartitionedOverlay {
    disk_guid: String,
    root_partition: PartitionPin,
    upgrade_partition: PartitionPin,
    upgrade_fsid: String,
    host_upgrade_fsid: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct CleanPlan {
    version: u8,
    session_id: String,
    wireguard_pubkey: String,
    expected_revision: u64,
    expected_revision_operation_id: String,
    binding: SledBtrfsDevice,
    seed_device: String,
    seed_fsid: String,
    seed_generation: u64,
    leaf_inode: u64,
    leaf_size: u64,
    members: BTreeMap<String, MemberPin>,
    persist_inode: u64,
    native_root: String,
    pool_name: String,
    pool_source: String,
    instance_etag: String,
    instance: JsonValue,
    previous_instance_etag: String,
    previous_instance: JsonValue,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    partitioned_overlay: Option<PartitionedOverlay>,
}

fn canonical(path: &str) -> bool {
    Path::new(path).is_absolute()
        && Path::new(path)
            .components()
            .all(|p| matches!(p, Component::RootDir | Component::Normal(_)))
}
fn native_uuid(instance: &JsonValue) -> Result<&str> {
    let value = instance["config"]["volatile.uuid"]
        .as_str()
        .context("native UUID missing")?;
    ensure!(
        uuid::Uuid::parse_str(value)?.to_string() == value,
        "native UUID is noncanonical"
    );
    Ok(value)
}
fn canonical_key(key: &str) -> Result<()> {
    let decoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.decode(key)?;
    ensure!(
        decoded.len() == 32 && base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(decoded) == key,
        "noncanonical public key"
    );
    Ok(())
}

impl CleanPlan {
    fn native_name(&self) -> Result<&str> {
        self.instance["name"].as_str().context("clean native name missing")
    }
    fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        let native_name = self.native_name()?;
        ensure!(native_name == CONTROL_PLANE_CHATBOT_CONTAINER || native_name == RESERVED_CHATBOT_CONTAINER
            || op_cozo_store::is_numbered_native_name(native_name),
            "invalid clean native name");
        canonical_key(&self.wireguard_pubkey)?;
        ensure!(
            matches!(self.version, 2 | 3 | 4)
                && self.session_id
                    == op_identity::session::derive_session_id(&self.wireguard_pubkey)
                && control_plane_chatbot_session_id().as_deref() == Some(self.session_id.as_str())
                && configured_chatbot_key().as_deref() == Some(self.wireguard_pubkey.as_str()),
            "clean adoption is only for the configured chatbot key"
        );
        if self.version == 4 {
            let layout = self.partitioned_overlay.as_ref().context("partitioned overlay pins absent")?;
            let root = &layout.root_partition;
            let upgrade = &layout.upgrade_partition;
            ensure!(self.binding.device_path == format!("{PARTITIONED_POOL}/{native_name}.img")
                && self.binding.mount_point == format!("{PARTITIONED_POOL}/.mounts/{native_name}/root")
                && root.start_sector == 2048 && root.sectors >= 2_097_152
                && root.start_sector.checked_add(root.sectors) == Some(upgrade.start_sector)
                && upgrade.sectors >= 2_097_152
                && upgrade.start_sector.checked_add(upgrade.sectors)
                    == self.leaf_size.checked_div(512).and_then(|sectors| sectors.checked_sub(2048))
                && self.leaf_size % 512 == 0,
                "partition geometry or external mount paths differ");
            let mut uuids = HashSet::new();
            for value in [&layout.disk_guid, &root.partuuid, &upgrade.partuuid, &layout.upgrade_fsid,
                &layout.host_upgrade_fsid, &self.seed_fsid, &self.binding.btrfs_uuid] {
                ensure!(uuid::Uuid::parse_str(value)?.to_string() == *value && uuids.insert(value),
                    "partition or filesystem identities are invalid or reused");
            }
            ensure!(layout.host_upgrade_fsid == "7ac6c955-4028-439c-80b4-c55a647abcb4",
                "host upgrade identity differs");
        } else {
            ensure!(self.partitioned_overlay.is_none(), "legacy plan includes partitioned layout");
        }
        ensure!(
            self.binding.cozo_id == self.session_id
                && self.binding.attached
                && self.leaf_inode > 0
                && self.leaf_size >= 1024 * 1024 * 1024
                && self.persist_inode > 256
                && self.seed_generation > 0
                && !self.instance_etag.is_empty(),
            "invalid clean storage/native provenance"
        );
        for path in [
            &self.seed_device,
            &self.binding.device_path,
            &self.binding.mount_point,
            &self.native_root,
            &self.pool_source,
        ] {
            ensure!(canonical(path), "noncanonical clean plan path");
        }
        ensure!(
            self.seed_device.starts_with("/dev/")
                && !self.binding.device_path.starts_with("/dev/")
                && uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&self.seed_fsid)?.to_string() == self.seed_fsid
                && uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&self.binding.btrfs_uuid)?.to_string()
                    == self.binding.btrfs_uuid
                && self.seed_fsid != self.binding.btrfs_uuid,
            "invalid shared seed/leaf identities"
        );
        ensure!(
            self.members.len() == 7 && MEMBERS.iter().all(|name| self.members.contains_key(*name)),
            "clean plan requires exactly seven inherited siblings"
        );
        let mut ids = HashSet::new();
        let mut uuids = HashSet::new();
        for pin in self.members.values() {
            ensure!(
                pin.id >= 256
                    && uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&pin.uuid)?.to_string() == pin.uuid
                    && ids.insert(pin.id)
                    && uuids.insert(&pin.uuid),
                "invalid inherited member identities"
            );
        }
        ensure!(
            self.pool_name == "identity-roots"
                && self.native_root
                    == format!(
                        "/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/{}/containers/{}/rootfs",
                        self.pool_name, native_name
                    )
                && (self.version != 4 || self.pool_source == "/var/lib/incus-storage/identity-roots")
                && self.instance["type"] == "container"
                && self.instance["status"] == "Stopped"
                && self.instance["status_code"] == 102,
            "clean plan requires the stopped fresh native container"
        );
        native_uuid(&self.instance)?;
        if self.version == 2 {
            ensure!(
                !self.previous_instance_etag.is_empty()
                    && self.previous_instance["type"] == "container"
                    && self.previous_instance["status"] == "Stopped"
                    && self.previous_instance["name"] != self.instance["name"]
                    && native_uuid(&self.instance)? != native_uuid(&self.previous_instance)?,
                "replacement requires distinct stopped native containers"
            );
        } else {
            ensure!(
                self.previous_instance.is_null() && self.previous_instance_etag.is_empty(),
                "post-deletion provision must not import the previous native record"
            );
        }
        ensure!(
            self.instance["profiles"] == serde_json::json!(["3tched-lungs"]),
            "unexpected fresh native profiles"
        );
        for config_field in ["config", "expanded_config"] {
            let config = self.instance[config_field]
                .as_object()
                .context("native config absent")?;
            ensure!(
                config
                    .get("security.privileged")
                    .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
                    == Some("false")
                    && config.get("security.nesting").and_then(JsonValue::as_str) == Some("false")
                    && config
                        .get("security.protection.shift")
                        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
                        == Some("true")
                    && config.get("boot.autostart").and_then(JsonValue::as_str) == Some("false")
                    && config
                        .get("security.syscalls.deny_default")
                        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
                        == Some("true")
                    && config
                        .get("user.opdbus.session_id")
                        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
                        == Some(self.session_id.as_str())
                    && config
                        .get("user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key")
                        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
                        == Some(self.wireguard_pubkey.as_str())
                    && config.get("raw.lxc").and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
                        == Some(format!("lxc.uts.name = {}", self.session_id).as_str())
                    && !config.contains_key("raw.seccomp")
                    && !config.contains_key("security.syscalls.allow")
                    && !config.contains_key("security.syscalls.whitelist")
                    && config
                        .keys()
                        .all(|key| !key.starts_with("raw.") || key == "raw.lxc"),
                "fresh native identity/security policy differs"
            );
            let deny = config
                .get("security.syscalls.deny")
                .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
                .context("native storage protection absent")?;
            let expected: std::collections::BTreeSet<_> = [
                "ioctl errno 1 [1,0x4008941a,SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ,0xffffffff]",
                "ioctl errno 1 [1,0x5000940f,SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ,0xffffffff]",
                "ioctl errno 1 [1,0x5000943f,SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ,0xffffffff]",
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .collect();
            ensure!(
                deny.lines()
                    .map(str::trim)
                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
                    .collect::<std::collections::BTreeSet<_>>()
                    == expected,
                "native storage protection differs"
            );
        }
        for field in ["devices", "expanded_devices"] {
            let devices = self.instance[field]
                .as_object()
                .context("native disks absent")?;
            ensure!(
                devices.iter().all(|(name, d)| d["type"] == "disk"
                    || (self.version == 4 && name == "fuse"
                        && *d == serde_json::json!({"type":"unix-char","source":"/dev/fuse","path":"/dev/fuse"})))
                    && devices["root"]["path"] == "/"
                    && devices["root"]["pool"] == self.pool_name,
                "fresh native requires disk-only devices and pinned root"
            );
            if self.version == 4 {
                ensure!(devices.get("fuse") == Some(&serde_json::json!(
                    {"type":"unix-char","source":"/dev/fuse","path":"/dev/fuse"}))
                    && !devices.contains_key("3tchedfs") && !devices.contains_key("system-bus"),
                    "partitioned guest must own its FUSE mount without a host bus bind");
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    fn validate_expected(&self, expected: &IdentityRevision) -> Result<()> {
        self.validate()?;
        ensure!(
            expected.session_id == self.session_id
                && expected.revision == self.expected_revision
                && expected.operation_id == self.expected_revision_operation_id,
            "clean plan revision changed"
        );
        if self.version == 3 {
            ensure!(
                deleted_for_provision(expected),
                "fresh provision requires the exact explicit deletion tombstone"
            );
            return Ok(());
        }
        if self.version == 4 {
            ensure!(fresh_for_provision(expected) || deleted_for_provision(expected),
                "partitioned adoption requires a fresh key or explicit deletion tombstone");
            return Ok(());
        }
        let old = expected
            .record
            .as_ref()
            .context("clean replacement requires existing identity")?;
        let old_instance: IncusInstance = serde_json::from_str(&old.instance_json)?;
        ensure!(
            expected.session_id == self.session_id
                && expected.revision == self.expected_revision
                && expected.operation_id == self.expected_revision_operation_id
                && old.wireguard_pubkey == self.wireguard_pubkey
                && old_instance.name
                    == self.previous_instance["name"]
                        .as_str()
                        .context("old native name missing")?
                && old_instance
                    .config
                    .as_ref()
                    .and_then(|c| c.get("volatile.uuid"))
                    .map(String::as_str)
                    == Some(native_uuid(&self.previous_instance)?)
                && old.btrfs_device_json != serde_json::to_string(&self.binding)?,
            "clean plan does not match previous authoritative binding/revision"
        );
        if let Some(device) = revision_sled(expected)?.and_then(|sled| sled.btrfs_device) {
            ensure!(
                device.device_path != self.binding.device_path
                    && device.mount_point != self.binding.mount_point
                    && device.btrfs_uuid != self.binding.btrfs_uuid,
                "clean adoption cannot reuse old leaf storage"
            );
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn fresh_for_provision(expected: &IdentityRevision) -> bool {
    expected.revision == 0 && expected.operation_id.is_empty()
        && expected.record.is_none() && expected.genesis.is_none()
}

fn deleted_for_provision(expected: &IdentityRevision) -> bool {
    expected.revision > 1
        && expected.record.is_none()
        && expected.genesis.is_none()
        && expected.operation_id
            == format!(
                "delete-provision-{}-{}",
                expected.session_id,
                expected.revision - 1
            )
}

fn parsed_native(raw: &JsonValue) -> Result<IncusInstance> {
    IncusPlugin::instance_from_native_metadata(raw.clone())
}

pub(super) fn binding_matches(pinned: &str, current: &str) -> bool {
    op_cozo_store::clean_provision_instance_binding_matches(pinned, current)
}
async fn receipt(store: &IdentitySledStore, sid: &str) -> Result<Option<CleanProvisionReceipt>> {
    let cozo = store.cozo.clone();
    let sid = sid.to_owned();
    Ok(tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || cozo.read_clean_provision(&sid)).await??)
}
async fn native_proof(
    plan: &CleanPlan,
    strict_stopped: bool,
) -> Result<(storage::StorageGuard, IncusInstance)> {
    let native = IncusRootRepairBackend::local();
    let (instance, etag) = native.instance(plan.native_name()?).await?;
    if strict_stopped {
        ensure!(
            instance == plan.instance && etag == plan.instance_etag,
            "fresh native definition/ETag changed"
        );
        if plan.version == 2 {
            let (old, old_etag) = native
                .instance(
                    plan.previous_instance["name"]
                        .as_str()
                        .context("old native name absent")?,
                )
                .await?;
            ensure!(
                old == plan.previous_instance && old_etag == plan.previous_instance_etag,
                "retained old native definition/ETag changed"
            );
        }
    } else {
        ensure!(
            binding_matches(
                &serde_json::to_string(&parsed_native(&plan.instance)?)?,
                &serde_json::to_string(&parsed_native(&instance)?)?
            ),
            "clean native storage/UUID/config changed"
        );
    }
    let pool = native
        .pool(&plan.pool_name)
        .await?
        .context("native pool absent")?;
    ensure!(
        pool["driver"] == "dir"
            && pool["status"] == "Created"
            && pool["config"]["source"] == plan.pool_source,
        "native root pool changed"
    );
    let parsed = parsed_native(&instance)?;
    let plan = plan.clone();
    let guard = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || storage::verify(&plan)).await??;
    Ok((guard, parsed))
}

pub(super) struct CleanRootGuard {
    pub should_start: bool,
    _storage: storage::StorageGuard,
}

pub(super) async fn guard_start(
    store: &IdentitySledStore,
    revision: &IdentityRevision,
    sled: &ContainerIdentitySled,
) -> Result<Option<CleanRootGuard>> {
    let Some(receipt) = receipt(store, &sled.session_id).await? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let plan: CleanPlan = serde_json::from_str(&receipt.provenance_json)?;
    plan.validate()?;
    ensure!(
        revision.revision >= receipt.committed_revision
            && sled.wireguard_pubkey == plan.wireguard_pubkey
            && sled.btrfs_device.as_ref().is_some_and(|device| {
                let mut device = device.clone();
                device.attached = true;
                device == plan.binding
            })
            && sled.instance.as_ref().is_some_and(|i| binding_matches(
                &receipt.instance_json,
                &serde_json::to_string(i).unwrap_or_default()
            )),
        "clean receipt does not match authoritative binding"
    );
    let (guard, native) = native_proof(&plan, false).await?;
    let should_start = root_repair::decide_seeded_native_start(sled.active, &native.status)?;
    Ok(Some(CleanRootGuard {
        should_start,
        _storage: guard,
    }))
}

pub(super) async fn observe_power(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    store: &IdentitySledStore,
    revision: &IdentityRevision,
    sled: &ContainerIdentitySled,
    status: &str,
) -> Result<Option<IncusInstance>> {
    let Some(_guard) = guard_start(store, revision, sled).await? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let snapshot = IncusRootRepairBackend::local()
        .default_project_state()
        .await?;
    let instance = snapshot
        .instances
        .iter()
        .find(|instance| sled.instance.as_ref().is_some_and(|stored| instance.name == stored.name))
        .context("clean native power readback absent")?
        .clone();
    ensure!(
        instance.status == status && identity_instance_matches(sled, &instance),
        "clean native power readback differs"
    );
    crate::incus_observer::publish_repair_readback_locked(engine, &snapshot).await?;
    Ok(Some(instance))
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(super) async fn provision(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    store: &IdentitySledStore,
    actor: VerifiedIdentityActor<'_>,
    input: seed_provision::ProvisionInput,
    seal: seed_provision::ProvisionSealPin,
    _request_operation: &str,
    preflight: bool,
) -> Result<JsonValue> {
    canonical_key(&input.wireguard_pubkey)?;
    let sid = op_identity::session::derive_session_id(&input.wireguard_pubkey);
    ensure!(
        control_plane_chatbot_session_id().as_deref() == Some(sid.as_str())
            && configured_chatbot_key().as_deref() == Some(input.wireguard_pubkey.as_str()),
        "clean provision requires configured chatbot key"
    );
    let _lifecycle = store.lifecycle_lock(&sid).await.lock_owned().await;
    let _host = engine.lock_host_observation().await;
    seed_provision::admit(
        engine,
        store,
        actor.actor_id,
        actor.session_id,
        actor.genesis,
        &seal,
    )
    .await?;
    seed_provision::target_key_is_registered(&input.wireguard_pubkey).await?;
    let expected = load_revision(store, &sid).await?;
    let old = revision_sled(&expected)?;
    ensure!(
        old.as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|old| old.wireguard_pubkey == input.wireguard_pubkey)
            || deleted_for_provision(&expected) || fresh_for_provision(&expected),
        "clean provision requires the existing key or its explicit deletion tombstone"
    );
    if preflight {
        preflight_native_identity_effect().await?;
        let Some(old) = old else {
            seed_provision::admit(
                engine,
                store,
                actor.actor_id,
                actor.session_id,
                actor.genesis,
                &seal,
            )
            .await?;
            return Ok(
                serde_json::json!({"session_id":sid,"wireguard_pubkey":input.wireguard_pubkey,"expected_revision":expected.revision,"expected_revision_operation_id":expected.operation_id,
                "previous_instance":null,"previous_instance_etag":"","previous_native_instance":null}),
            );
        };
        let stored_instance = old
            .instance
            .context("previous native instance binding absent")?;
        let (native, etag) = delete_provision::retirement_native(&stored_instance)
            .await?
            .unwrap_or((JsonValue::Null, String::new()));
        seed_provision::admit(
            engine,
            store,
            actor.actor_id,
            actor.session_id,
            actor.genesis,
            &seal,
        )
        .await?;
        return Ok(
            serde_json::json!({"session_id":sid,"wireguard_pubkey":input.wireguard_pubkey,"expected_revision":expected.revision,"expected_revision_operation_id":expected.operation_id,
            "previous_instance":stored_instance,"previous_instance_etag":etag,"previous_native_instance":native}),
        );
    }
    ensure!(
        root_repair::valid_digest(&input.plan_sha256),
        "invalid adoption digest"
    );
    let digest = input.plan_sha256.clone();
    let read_sid = sid.clone();
    let bytes = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
        root_repair::trusted_plan_bytes_at(Path::new(PLAN_DIR), &read_sid, &digest, 0)
    })
    .await??;
    let plan: CleanPlan = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?;
    plan.validate()?;
    let operation = format!("clean-provision-{}", input.plan_sha256);
    if let Some(receipt) = receipt(store, &sid).await?
        && receipt.plan_sha256 == input.plan_sha256
    {
        ensure!(
            receipt.provenance_json == serde_json::to_string(&plan)?,
            "replay plan changed"
        );
        let old = old.context("clean replay record missing")?;
        guard_start(store, &expected, &old)
            .await?
            .context("clean replay storage receipt missing")?;
        seed_provision::admit(
            engine,
            store,
            actor.actor_id,
            actor.session_id,
            actor.genesis,
            &seal,
        )
        .await?;
        recover_identity_startup_with_store(engine, store).await?;
        return Ok(
            serde_json::json!({"identity":old,"plan_sha256":input.plan_sha256,"operation_id":receipt.operation_id,"committed_revision":receipt.committed_revision,"replayed":true}),
        );
    }
    plan.validate_expected(&expected)?;
    preflight_native_identity_effect().await?;
    let (_storage, instance) = native_proof(&plan, true).await?;
    let timestamp = now();
    let mut fresh: ContainerIdentitySled = serde_json::from_value(
        serde_json::json!({"session_id":sid,"wireguard_pubkey":input.wireguard_pubkey}),
    )?;
    fresh.schema_version = RECORD_FORMAT;
    fresh.principal_kind = Some("service".to_string());
    fresh.btrfs_device = Some(plan.binding.clone());
    fresh.instance = Some(instance);
    fresh.session_started_at = timestamp;
    fresh.last_seen_at = timestamp;
    let stamp = engine
        .mint_identity_genesis_stamp(&sid, &fresh.wireguard_pubkey, 0)
        .await?;
    apply_genesis_stamp(&mut fresh, &stamp)?;
    validate_sled(&fresh)?;
    ensure!(
        load_revision(store, &sid).await? == expected,
        "identity changed during external adoption proof"
    );
    seed_provision::admit(
        engine,
        store,
        actor.actor_id,
        actor.session_id,
        actor.genesis,
        &seal,
    )
    .await?;
    let (_final_storage, _) = native_proof(&plan, true).await?;
    let cozo = store.cozo.clone();
    let operation_for_commit = operation.clone();
    let plan_hash = input.plan_sha256.clone();
    let record = sled_to_record(&fresh)?;
    let genesis = sled_to_genesis(&fresh);
    let provenance = serde_json::to_string(&plan)?;
    let value = fresh.clone();
    let publication = engine
        .commit_identity_intent(operation.clone(), move |_| {
            let committed = cozo.apply_identity_intent(
                &sid,
                &operation_for_commit,
                IdentityIntent::CleanProvision(Box::new(IdentityCleanProvision {
                    expected,
                    record,
                    genesis,
                    plan_sha256: plan_hash,
                    provenance_json: provenance,
                })),
            )?;
            let state = cozo.read_identity_recovery_state(MAX_EVENTS_IN_STATE)?;
            Ok((
                Some(state_value(&state)?),
                DurableResult {
                    value: (value, committed.current.revision),
                    replayed: committed.replayed,
                },
            ))
        })
        .await?;
    let (identity, committed_revision) = publication_value(publication)?;
    Ok(
        serde_json::json!({"identity":identity,"plan_sha256":input.plan_sha256,"operation_id":operation,"committed_revision":committed_revision,"replayed":false}),
    )
}

//! Read-only kernel/GPT proof for the operator-prepared upgrade-over-seed view.
use super::*;

fn crc32(bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    let mut value = !0u32;
    for byte in bytes {
        value ^= u32::from(*byte);
        for _ in 0..8 {
            value = (value >> 1) ^ (0xedb8_8320 & (0u32.wrapping_sub(value & 1)));
        }
    }
    !value
}

pub(super) fn verify_partition(
    device: &File,
    image: &File,
    backing: &std::fs::Metadata,
    layout: &PartitionedOverlay,
    number: u8,
) -> Result<File> {
    let pin = match number { 1 => &layout.root_partition, 2 => &layout.upgrade_partition,
        _ => anyhow::bail!("unsupported identity partition") };
    let mut header = [0u8; 92];
    image.read_exact_at(&mut header, 512)?;
    let header_crc = u32::from_le_bytes(header[16..20].try_into()?);
    header[16..20].fill(0);
    ensure!(&header[..8] == b"EFI PART" && u32::from_le_bytes(header[8..12].try_into()?) == 0x10000
        && u32::from_le_bytes(header[12..16].try_into()?) == 92 && crc32(&header) == header_crc
        && u64::from_le_bytes(header[24..32].try_into()?) == 1
        && u64::from_le_bytes(header[32..40].try_into()?) == backing.len() / 512 - 1
        && uuid::Uuid::from_bytes_le(header[56..72].try_into()?).to_string() == layout.disk_guid
        && u64::from_le_bytes(header[72..80].try_into()?) == 2
        && u32::from_le_bytes(header[80..84].try_into()?) == 128
        && u32::from_le_bytes(header[84..88].try_into()?) == 128,
        "protected image GPT header differs");
    let mut table = [0u8; 16384];
    image.read_exact_at(&mut table, 1024)?;
    ensure!(crc32(&table) == u32::from_le_bytes(header[88..92].try_into()?)
        && table[256..].iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0), "GPT is corrupt or includes another partition");
    let entry = &table[(usize::from(number) - 1) * 128..usize::from(number) * 128];
    ensure!(uuid::Uuid::from_bytes_le(entry[..16].try_into()?).to_string()
            == "0fc63daf-8483-4772-8e79-3d69d8477de4"
        && uuid::Uuid::from_bytes_le(entry[16..32].try_into()?).to_string() == pin.partuuid
        && u64::from_le_bytes(entry[32..40].try_into()?) == pin.start_sector
        && u64::from_le_bytes(entry[40..48].try_into()?).checked_add(1)
            == pin.start_sector.checked_add(pin.sectors), "GPT partition pin differs");
    let meta = device.metadata()?;
    ensure!(meta.file_type().is_block_device(), "partition is not a block device");
    let sysfs = format!("/sys/dev/block/{}:{}", libc::major(meta.rdev()), libc::minor(meta.rdev()));
    let kernel_name = std::fs::read_link(&sysfs)?;
    let kernel_name = kernel_name.file_name().and_then(|name| name.to_str()).context("partition name unavailable")?;
    let suffix = format!("p{number}");
    let loop_name = kernel_name.strip_suffix(&suffix).context("wrong loop partition number")?;
    let loop_number = loop_name.strip_prefix("loop").context("partition parent is not loop storage")?;
    ensure!(!loop_number.is_empty() && loop_number.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit()), "invalid loop parent");
    for (field, expected) in [("partition", u64::from(number)), ("start", pin.start_sector), ("size", pin.sectors)] {
        let value = std::fs::read_to_string(format!("{sysfs}/{field}"))?;
        ensure!(value.len() <= 32 && value.trim().parse::<u64>()? == expected, "kernel partition geometry differs");
    }
    let parent = open(Path::new(&format!("/dev/{loop_name}")), false)?;
    let mut status: LoopInfo = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
    // SAFETY: held loop descriptor and ABI-sized LOOP_GET_STATUS64 output.
    ensure!(unsafe { libc::ioctl(parent.as_raw_fd(), 0x4c05 as libc::c_ulong, &mut status) } == 0
        && status.number.to_string() == loop_number && loop_matches(&status, backing, false),
        "partition loop does not own the pinned image");
    Ok(parent)
}

fn subvolume_info(file: &File) -> Result<[u8; 504]> {
    let mut info = [0u8; 504];
    // SAFETY: exact btrfs_ioctl_get_subvol_info_args and a held Btrfs descriptor.
    ensure!(unsafe { libc::ioctl(file.as_raw_fd(), 0x81f8_943c as libc::c_ulong, info.as_mut_ptr()) } == 0,
        "upgrade subvolume identity unavailable");
    Ok(info)
}

#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct PairReceipt {

fn readonly_overlay(path: &Path, mounts: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    let mut found = false;
    let mountinfo = std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/self/mountinfo")?;
    for line in mountinfo.lines() {
        let Some((left, right)) = line.split_once(" - ") else { continue; };
        let left = left.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let right = right.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
        if left.get(4).copied() != path.to_str() { continue; }
        ensure!(left.get(5).is_some_and(|options| options.split(',').any(|option| option == "ro"))
            && right.first() == Some(&"overlay"), "guest root is not a read-only overlay");
        let expected = format!("lowerdir={}/upgrade-layer:{}/seed-layer", mounts.display(), mounts.display());
        ensure!(right.get(2).is_some_and(|options| options.split(',').any(|option| option == expected)),
            "overlay layers differ from the pinned identity");
        found = true;
    }
    ensure!(found, "overlay mount absent");
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn verify_overlay(
    plan: &CleanPlan, image: &File, backing: &std::fs::Metadata, seed_root: &File, guest: &File,
) -> Result<Vec<File>> {
    let layout = plan.partitioned_overlay.as_ref().context("overlay plan absent")?;
    let name = plan.native_name()?;
    let mounts = Path::new(PARTITIONED_POOL).join(".mounts").join(name);
    let view_path = mounts.join("root-view");
    let view = open_controlled(&view_path, true, Some(&view_path), None)?;
    readonly_overlay(&view_path, &mounts)?;
    readonly_overlay(Path::new(&plan.native_root), &mounts)?;
    ensure!(view.metadata()?.dev() == guest.metadata()?.dev()
        && view.metadata()?.ino() == guest.metadata()?.ino() && guest.metadata()?.uid() == 1000000,
        "Incus root is not the UID-mapped overlay view");
    let seed_layer_path = mounts.join("seed-layer");
    let seed_layer = open_controlled(&seed_layer_path, true, Some(&seed_layer_path), None)?;
    fs_info(&seed_layer, &plan.binding.btrfs_uuid)?;
    member_identity(&seed_layer, &plan.members["@"], false)?;
    ensure!(seed_layer.metadata()?.dev() == seed_root.metadata()?.dev()
        && seed_layer.metadata()?.ino() == seed_root.metadata()?.ino()
        && seed_layer.metadata()?.uid() == 1000000, "seed layer is not the mapped inherited @");
    let upgrade_path = mounts.join("upgrade");
    let upgrade = open(&upgrade_path, true)?;
    let upgrade_fs = fs_info(&upgrade, &layout.upgrade_fsid)?;
    ensure!(subvolume(&upgrade)? == 5 && upgrade_fs.max_id == 1, "upgrade is not standalone partition storage");
    let mut device: DevInfo = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() }; device.devid = 1;
    // SAFETY: exact DEV_INFO ABI and the held upgrade descriptor.
    ensure!(unsafe { libc::ioctl(upgrade.as_raw_fd(), 0xd000_941e as libc::c_ulong, &mut device) } == 0,
        "upgrade device identity unavailable");
    let end = device.path.iter().position(|byte| *byte == 0).context("upgrade device path invalid")?;
    let partition = open(Path::new(std::str::from_utf8(&device.path[..end])?), false)?;
    let parent = verify_partition(&partition, image, backing, layout, 2)?;
    let published_path = upgrade_path.join("@");
    let published = open_controlled(&published_path, true, Some(&published_path), None)?;
    let upgrade_layer_path = mounts.join("upgrade-layer");
    let upgrade_layer = open_controlled(&upgrade_layer_path, true, Some(&upgrade_layer_path), None)?;
    fs_info(&published, &layout.upgrade_fsid)?;
    fs_info(&upgrade_layer, &layout.upgrade_fsid)?;
    ensure!(published.metadata()?.dev() == upgrade_layer.metadata()?.dev()
        && published.metadata()?.ino() == upgrade_layer.metadata()?.ino()
        && upgrade_layer.metadata()?.uid() == 1000000, "upgrade layer is not the mapped published @");
    for layer in [&seed_layer, &upgrade_layer] {
        let mut flags: libc::statvfs = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
        // SAFETY: held layer descriptor and native statvfs output.
        ensure!(unsafe { libc::fstatvfs(layer.as_raw_fd(), &mut flags) } == 0
            && flags.f_flag & libc::ST_RDONLY != 0, "overlay layer lost mount read-only protection");
    }
    let pair_path = Path::new(PARTITIONED_POOL).join(".provisioning").join(format!("{name}.upgrade.json"));
    let pair = open(&pair_path, false)?;
    let pair_meta = pair.metadata()?;
    ensure!(pair_meta.is_file() && pair_meta.uid() == 0 && pair_meta.mode() & 0o077 == 0
        && pair_meta.len() <= 4096, "upgrade pair receipt is not protected and bounded");
    let mut bytes = vec![0; pair_meta.len() as usize];
    pair.read_exact_at(&mut bytes, 0)?;
    let receipt: PairReceipt = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?;
    ensure!(receipt.phase == "paired" && receipt.direction == "host-to-container"
        && receipt.host_fsid == layout.host_upgrade_fsid && receipt.replica_fsid == layout.upgrade_fsid
        && !receipt.generation.is_empty() && receipt.generation.len() <= 128
        && receipt.generation.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte == b'-'),
        "upgrade pair receipt differs from the adoption plan");
    let received_path = upgrade_path.join(".upgrade-sync").join(name).join(&receipt.generation);
    let received = open(&received_path, true)?;
    let host_path = Path::new(PARTITIONED_POOL).join(".mounts/host-upgrade/.upgrade-sync")
        .join(name).join(&receipt.generation);
    let host = open(&host_path, true)?;
    fs_info(&received, &layout.upgrade_fsid)?;
    fs_info(&host, &layout.host_upgrade_fsid)?;
    let published_info = subvolume_info(&published)?;
    let received_info = subvolume_info(&received)?;
    let host_info = subvolume_info(&host)?;
    ensure!(u64::from_ne_bytes(received_info[288..296].try_into()?) & 1 != 0
        && u64::from_ne_bytes(host_info[288..296].try_into()?) & 1 != 0
        && published_info[312..328] == received_info[296..312]
        && received_info[328..344] == host_info[296..312], "incremental upgrade baseline ancestry differs");
    Ok(vec![view, seed_layer, upgrade, partition, parent, published, upgrade_layer, pair, received, host])
}
